title: Statistical Optimality of Prediction-Powered Inference
summary: The prediction-powered inference (PPI) proposed by Angelopoulos et al. (2023) is a popular method that leverages a small number of labeled samples and machine learning predictions for semi-supervised inference. While several variants of PPI have appeared in the literature, its rigorous statistical theory has not been fully developed. In this paper, we study the statistical optimality of PPI. Our contributions span both foundational theory and new methodology.
